critical_bugs: Unhandled KeyError in rebuild_from_deep_memory: direct access to deep_memory['object_tracks'] without verifying key existence will crash if the deep memory file lacks this field.
Missing error handling around pickle.load(f) for deep_learning_memory.pkl; corrupted or truncated files will cause unhandled UnpicklingError/EOFError crashes during rebuild.
Insecure deserialization: Using pickle to load persistent data exposes the system to arbitrary code execution if the .pkl file is tampered with, corrupted, or sourced from an untrusted pipeline.
warnings: Broad 'except Exception:' in _load() masks specific I/O errors (e.g., permission denied, disk full), hindering diagnostics and recovery.
Linear O(N) iteration in get_entity_by_motive_marker and get_entity_by_slam_cluster will degrade performance as the registry scales beyond hundreds of entities.
recommendations: Replace pickle with JSON or a secure serialization format (e.g., msgpack, protobuf) to eliminate deserialization vulnerabilities.
Wrap all file I/O and deserialization operations in try/except blocks with specific exception handling and graceful fallback mechanisms.
Implement reverse lookup dictionaries (marker->entity_id, cluster->entity_id) for O(1) retrieval instead of full registry scans.
Validate and sanitize root_path input to ensure it resolves to an expected directory structure before file operations.
